name: Business Day Search Criteria 2
definition: Defines the criteria used to search for system business day information.

SystemDate.name: System Date
SystemDate.definition: Date for which the availability information is provided.

SystemIdentification.name: System Identification
SystemIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of the system, as assigned by the system administrator.

SystemCurrency.name: System Currency
SystemCurrency.definition: Currency which may be processed by the system. A system may process transactions in a single currency or in multiple currencies.

EventType.name: Event Type
EventType.definition: Nature of the event that has occurred.

ClosurePeriod.name: Closure Period
ClosurePeriod.definition: Period of time when the system is closed/not operating.
